summary: Tested new HR Letters feature (request, approve/reject, direct issue, PDF, public verify, settings + letterhead/signature uploads) and bulk card-photo approvals + dashboard HR alerts. Backend 22/22 pytest tests passed against public URL. Frontend: /verify-letter?token=bad renders verify-letter-card + verify-invalid; admin /hr-letters shows hero, tabs (pending/approved/rejected/all/mine), letters-settings-btn, letters-direct-btn, letters-request-btn; settings modal shows letter-img-letterhead preview, signer fields, save button; approved tab shows letter-pdf-<id> buttons; pending row click opens letter-detail-modal with prefilled Arabic draft in letter-body and approve/reject/note controls. /hr-photo-approvals renders empty state 'لا توجد صور بانتظار الاعتماد' when no pending; grid + select-all + selected-count + bulk-approve/reject wired. Dashboard hr tab (dash-view-tab-hr) shows dash-alert-hr_pending_letters and dash-alert-hr_pending_photos. Employee 9999 /hr-letters shows only letters-request-btn (no direct/settings). Cleanup ran successfully.

issues: Repeated warnings: 'shadow* deprecated', 'pointerEvents deprecated' from react-native-web; harmless but should be cleaned up.
React error 'Unexpected text node' logged during navigation between screens — non-blocking but indicates stray whitespace inside a <View>.

critical_code_review_comments: hr_letters.py /settings/{kind} POST uses a path param to distinguish letterhead vs signature — a typo path returns a plain 404 which is fine, but consider explicit validation.
verify-letter.tsx: loading spinner has no data-testid; consider verify-letter-loading for stricter test hooks.
list_letters counts are computed with N (=4) round-trips (one count_documents per status) — could be aggregated in a single facet pipeline.
default_body composes long Arabic strings — good; consider extracting per-type builders once file grows further (still under 400 lines so acceptable).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical testIDs present, key flows verified)

Signature image is re-uploaded at the end so PDF issuance keeps working.
